title: Handling 401 and 403: redirect and sign out

objectives.text: State the general HTTP meanings of 401 (the request lacks valid authentication credentials) and 403 (the server understood the request but refuses it), then apply the project API contract: 401 means sign in again, 403 means keep the session and show not-authorized
On a 401, clear the client-side authentication state and redirect to the login page, remembering the page to return to, and distinguish that from the server ending an HttpOnly cookie session
On a 403, show a not-allowed message instead of signing the user out
